title: Calculator
instruction: Define add(a, b) and multiply(a, b) functions that return values.
initialCode:
# Exercise: Calculator

def add(a, b):
    return a + b

def multiply(a, b):
    return a * b

title: Palindrome Checker
instruction: Write a function is_palindrome(word) that returns True if word reads the same forward and backward.
initialCode:
# Exercise: Palindrome Checker

def is_palindrome(word):
    clean = word.lower()
    return clean == clean[::-1]

print("radar:", is_palindrome("radar"))
print("python:", is_palindrome("python"))
